description: Wikipedia lookup: searches a topic and returns the best-matching article's title, short description, plain-text summary, URL and thumbnail, plus other matching titles (lang= for other Wikipedias, default en). Text CC BY-SA 4.0. Costs 0.01 USDC on Base via x402, or 12 sats Cashu ecash (NUT-24), or 12 sats over Lightning (L402).
